title: It's about time
content: Meaning/Usage: When you want to express that you waited a long time. A synonym of this would be, "finally." Explanation: When you wait for something, the time on a clock is the biggest factor. "It's about time." "It's about time. I waited two hours for you." "It's about time I got a chance to play." A: "I've been waiting for 3 weeks to try out the new laptop. Isn't it my turn yet?" B: "Yes. It's your turn. I'll get it for you." A: "It's about time."

examples.sentence: It's about time. I waited two hours for you.
It's about time I got a chance to play.
I've been waiting for 3 weeks to try out the new laptop. Isn't it my turn yet?
Yes. It's your turn. I'll get it for you.
